dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000q7ex](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000q7ex) Magnitude 5.4 earthquake at 10.0 depth occurred on Apr 20 2025 58km N of Palau Geser. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -3.3636 longitude 131.0017. It impacted 21912 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
